title: edikt hook soak gate record
description: Written by `edikt hook soak --group <n>` at .edikt/state/hook-soak/group-<n>.soak.json, and referenced by Phase 15 (group 1) / Phase 19 (group 2) of PLAN-v080-reliability-core's soak gates (SPEC-014 spec.md §'Dogfood soak', AC-007-1). Records, per migrated hook in the named group, whether that hook has journal invocation evidence within the soak window and whether any disqualifying outcome (panic-recovered, unregistered-hook-name, or hook-binary-absent) was observed in that same window. `elapsed_days` is always derived from the git commit date of the group's last migration commit (D2/D2 owner ruling, 2026-08-20) — never from a gitignored state file — so the gate reproduces the identical verdict on a fresh clone as it did on the machine that ran it. A journal that could not be read at all is recorded as `journal_status: unknown` for every hook in the group, never as zero invocations, so an unreadable journal cannot render as a clean soak (INV-013).

schema_version.description: Contract version for this soak record's on-disk shape. Integer, matching every other machine-state contract in the phasea/hook family (phasea-dispatch-plan.v1, phasea-receipt.v1, phasea-journal.v1, hook-registry.v1, hook-corpus-matrix.v1, hook-corpus-recording.v1) — added at authoring time rather than retrofitted later, since Phase 15/19 gate the riskiest work in PLAN-v080-reliability-core on this format and it must not repeat phasea-journal.v1's pre-flight gap of shipping with none.

group.description: Which FR-007 migration group this soak record covers: 1 = the simple-injector group (Phase 15's gate), 2 = the multi-call-hook group (Phase 19's gate). Group 3 (the write-deny gates) has no soak gate of its own — FR-007's migration order runs group 3 immediately after group 2's soak, on convention maturity rather than a third wall-clock window (spec.md 'FR-007 — migration order').

since_commit.description: The git commit hash (abbreviated or full) of this group's last migration commit — the point `elapsed_days` counts forward from. Recorded explicitly so the derivation in `elapsed_days` is independently reproducible from git history alone, without trusting the number this record states.

elapsed_days.description: Whole days between `since_commit`'s commit date and the soak check's run time, computed fresh at check time from `git log -1 --format=%cI <since_commit>` — never persisted from, or compared against, a gitignored state file (D2 owner ruling: 'elapsed days is a reported fact, derived from git, not a gitignored state file'). Reported here as a fact alongside the per-hook invocation evidence, not as the gate's pass/fail criterion by itself — a group can be day-14 and still refuse if any hook has zero invocation evidence or a disqualifying outcome.

hooks.description: One entry per hook `hook-registry.v1` lists as belonging to this group and already migrated (status: migrated). A group with zero migrated hooks never reaches a soak check — Phase 15/19 do not run this gate until the whole group has landed — so this array is never empty for a soak record that was actually written.

journal_status.description: "observed" — the hook's journal window was read successfully, and `invocation_count` and the outcome counts below reflect what it contains, including zero. "unknown" — the journal could not be read for this hook in this window (absent file, unreadable window, or resolution failure); the gate MUST refuse on "unknown" as loudly as it does on a genuine zero, and MUST NOT report the counts below as 0 in this case — the counts are 0-valued placeholders only, not evidence, when journal_status is "unknown".

invocation_count.description: Number of journaled invocation records for this hook within the soak window. The gate refuses group-wide, naming this hook, when this is 0 with journal_status "observed" — a genuinely-zero, successfully-read count is exactly what proves the hook never actually ran during the window.

panic_recovered_count.description: Count of this hook's journal records in-window carrying the panic-recovered outcome (Phase 6's centralized dispatch-site recover()). Any non-zero value refuses the group's soak.

unregistered_hook_name_count.description: Count of this hook's journal records in-window carrying the unregistered-hook-name outcome. Any non-zero value refuses the group's soak.

binary_absent_count.description: Count of this hook's journal records in-window where the ratified exec-shim's binary-existence check found the edikt binary absent and emitted the static absence banner (ADR-063's minimal exec shim). Any non-zero value refuses the group's soak.

status.description: The gate's verdict for this run. "pass" only when every hook in `hooks` has journal_status "observed", invocation_count >= 1, and all three outcome counts at 0. "refused" otherwise, with `refusal_reasons` populated naming why.

refusal_reasons.description: Human-readable reasons this run refused, one per disqualifying condition found (e.g. "cwd-changed: zero invocation evidence in window", "file-changed: journal_status unknown", "post-tool-use: 2 panic-recovered outcome(s) in window"). Required to be non-empty whenever status is "refused" (see the if/then below); empty (or absent) when status is "pass", since a passing run has no reason to name.
